articles.title: Alzheimer's risk gene APOE4 may have a reversible weakness
articles.summary: Two Mount Sinai studies suggest APOE4 can damage brain blood vessels and encourage abnormal protein buildup. Blocking one signal reversed the vessel damage in aged mice, and a new stem-cell brain model could speed up the search for treatments.

articles.title: Sharks can hear nearly 250 feet away and pinpoint the source
articles.summary: A Florida Atlantic University study found that wild blacktip sharks can detect low-frequency sounds from up to 243 feet away and often turn away from them. The result shows sharks can tell the direction of distant sounds.

articles.title: Adult female pythons cause the most trouble in Florida
articles.summary: A new study suggests that removing large adult female Burmese pythons is the best way to shrink Florida's invasive population. Researchers built a point system to rank which snakes matter most.
